163	class DesktopIpcCoreGateway implements CoreGateway {
164	  final MobileFrbCoreGateway _frbFallback = MobileFrbCoreGateway();
165	
166	  /// Set once a daemon answered over IPC; avoids re-probing on every request.
167	  bool _daemonReady = false;
168	
169	  String _unixSocketPath() {
170	    final runtimeDir = Platform.environment['XDG_RUNTIME_DIR'];
171	    if (runtimeDir != null && runtimeDir.isNotEmpty) {
172	      return '$runtimeDir/liino-daemon.sock';
173	    }
174	    return '/tmp/liino-daemon.sock';
175	  }
176	
177	  /// Starts the daemon when no instance is listening, so the desktop build
178	  /// keeps audio alive after the GUI process exits.
179	  Future<bool> _ensureDaemon() async {
180	    if (_daemonReady) return true;
181	    if (!(Platform.isMacOS || Platform.isLinux)) return false;
182	
183	    final sockPath = _unixSocketPath();
184	    if (await _pingDaemon(sockPath)) {
185	      _daemonReady = true;
186	      return true;
187	    }
188	
189	    final binary = _locateDaemonBinary();
190	    if (binary == null) return false;
191	    try {
192	      await Process.start(
193	        binary,
194	        const <String>[],
195	        mode: ProcessStartMode.detached,
196	        workingDirectory: File(binary).parent.path,
197	      );
198	    } catch (_) {
199	      return false;
200	    }
201	
202	    for (var attempt = 0; attempt < 40; attempt++) {
203	      await Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 50));
204	      if (await _pingDaemon(sockPath)) {
205	        _daemonReady = true;
206	        return true;
207	      }
208	    }
209	    return false;
210	  }
211	
212	  Future<bool> _pingDaemon(String sockPath) async {
213	    if (!File(sockPath).existsSync()) return false;
214	    Socket? socket;
215	    try {
216	      socket = await Socket.connect(
217	        InternetAddress(sockPath, type: InternetAddressType.unix),
218	        0,
219	        timeout: const Duration(milliseconds: 200),
220	      );
221	      socket.write('${jsonEncode({'type': 'ping'})}\n');
222	      await socket.flush();
223	      final line = await utf8.decoder
224	          .bind(socket)
225	          .transform(const LineSplitter())
226	          .first
227	          .timeout(const Duration(milliseconds: 200));
228	      return (jsonDecode(line) as Map<String, dynamic>)['type'] == 'pong';
229	    } catch (_) {
230	      return false;
231	    } finally {
232	      socket?.destroy();
233	    }
234	  }
235	
236	  /// Resolution order: explicit override, bundle resource, then the workspace
237	  /// `target/release` directory (walking up from the executable for dev runs).
238	  String? _locateDaemonBinary() {
239	    final override = Platform.environment['LIINO_DAEMON_BIN'];
240	    if (override != null &&
241	        override.isNotEmpty &&
242	        File(override).existsSync()) {
243	      return override;
244	    }
245	
246	    final executable = File(Platform.resolvedExecutable);
247	    final bundled = File(
248	      '${executable.parent.parent.path}/Resources/liino-daemon',
249	    );
250	    if (bundled.existsSync()) return bundled.path;
251	
252	    var dir = executable.parent;
253	    for (var depth = 0; depth < 8; depth++) {
254	      final candidate = File('${dir.path}/target/release/liino-daemon');
255	      if (candidate.existsSync()) return candidate.path;
256	      final parent = dir.parent;
257	      if (parent.path == dir.path) break;
258	      dir = parent;
259	    }
260	    return null;
261	  }
262	
263	  Future<Map<String, dynamic>?> _sendUnixIpc(
264	    Map<String, dynamic> payload,
265	  ) async {
266	    if (!(Platform.isMacOS || Platform.isLinux)) {
267	      return null;
268	    }
269	    if (!await _ensureDaemon()) return null;
270	    final sockPath = _unixSocketPath();
271	    Socket? socket;
272	    try {
273	      socket = await Socket.connect(
274	        InternetAddress(sockPath, type: InternetAddressType.unix),
275	        0,
276	        timeout: const Duration(milliseconds: 500),
277	      );
278	      socket.write('${jsonEncode(payload)}\n');
279	      await socket.flush();
280	      final line = await utf8.decoder
281	          .bind(socket)
282	          .transform(const LineSplitter())
283	          .first
284	          .timeout(const Duration(milliseconds: 500));
285	      return jsonDecode(line) as Map<String, dynamic>;
286	    } catch (_) {
287	      return null;
288	    } finally {
289	      await socket?.close();
290	    }
291	  }
292	
293	  @override
294	  Future<GatewayStatus> getStatus({required String preferredMode}) async {
295	    final resp = await _sendUnixIpc({'type': 'get_status'});
296	    if (resp != null && resp['type'] == 'status') {
297	      return GatewayStatus(
298	        platformName: resp['platform'] as String? ?? Platform.operatingSystem,
299	        roleMode: resp['role_mode'] as String? ?? preferredMode,
300	        resolvedRole: resp['resolved_role'] as String? ?? 'receiver',
301	        activeTransport: resp['active_transport'] as String? ?? 'lan_wifi',
302	        isRunning: resp['is_running'] as bool? ?? false,
303	        viaDaemon: true,
304	        daemonPid: resp['pid'] as int?,
305	        canCaptureAudio: true,
306	        canPlayAudio: true,
307	        canVirtualMicrophone: resp['virtual_mic_installed'] as bool? ?? false,
308	        virtualMicDriver: resp['virtual_mic_driver'] as String?,
309	        rttMs: (resp['rtt_ms'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 0,
310	        jitterMs: (resp['jitter_ms'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 0.0,
311	        packetLossRate: (resp['packet_loss_rate'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 0.0,
312	        bitrate: (resp['bitrate'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 0,
313	        sampleRate: (resp['sample_rate'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 48000,
314	        bufferDurationMs: (resp['buffer_duration_ms'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 0,
315	        bluetoothAddress: resp['bluetooth_address'] as String?,
316	      );
317	    }
318	    return _frbFallback.getStatus(preferredMode: preferredMode);
319	  }
320	
321	  @override
322	  Future<void> setRoleMode(String mode) async {
323	    final resp = await _sendUnixIpc({'type': 'set_role_mode', 'mode': mode});
324	    if (resp == null) {
325	      await _frbFallback.setRoleMode(mode);
326	    }
327	  }
328	
329	  @override
330	  Future<void> setTransport(String transport) async {
331	    final resp = await _sendUnixIpc({
332	      'type': 'set_transport',
333	      'transport': transport,
334	    });
335	    if (resp == null) {
336	      await _frbFallback.setTransport(transport);
337	    }
338	  }
339	
340	  @override
341	  Future<void> startLink() async {
342	    final resp = await _sendUnixIpc({'type': 'start_link'});
343	    if (resp == null) {
344	      await _frbFallback.startLink();
345	    }
346	  }
347	
348	  @override
349	  Future<void> stopLink() async {
350	    final resp = await _sendUnixIpc({'type': 'stop_link'});
351	    if (resp == null) {
352	      await _frbFallback.stopLink();
353	    }
354	  }
355	
356	  @override
357	  Future<List<LiinoBluetoothDevice>> getBluetoothDevices() async {
358	    final resp = await _sendUnixIpc({'type': 'list_bluetooth_devices'});
359	    final devices = resp?['devices'];
360	    if (devices is! List) return const [];
361	    return devices
362	        .whereType<Map<String, dynamic>>()
363	        .map(
364	          (device) => LiinoBluetoothDevice(
365	            address: device['address'] as String? ?? '',
366	            name: device['name'] as String? ?? '',
367	          ),
368	        )
369	        .where((device) => device.address.isNotEmpty)
370	        .toList();
371	  }

11	import time

13	SOCK = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "/tmp/liino-daemon.sock"

15	
16	def rpc(sock, obj):
17	    sock.sendall((json.dumps(obj) + "\n").encode())
18	    buf = b""
19	    while not buf.endswith(b"\n"):
20	        chunk = sock.recv(65536)
21	        if not chunk:
22	            break
23	        buf += chunk
24	    line = buf.decode().strip()
25	    return json.loads(line) if line else None
26	
27	
28	def main():
29	    s = socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX, socket.SOCK_STREAM)

31	    s.connect(SOCK)
32	    print("connected", SOCK)
33	
34	    print("ping        ->", rpc(s, {"type": "ping"}))
35	    st0 = rpc(s, {"type": "get_status"})

37	
38	    print("start_link  ->", rpc(s, {"type": "start_link"}))

42	
43	    print("stop_link   ->", rpc(s, {"type": "stop_link"}))

45	    print("status(stop)->", {k: st2.get(k) for k in ("is_running",)})
46	
47	    print("shutdown    ->", rpc(s, {"type": "shutdown_daemon"}))
48	    s.close()
49	
50	    ok = (st0.get("is_running") is False and st1.get("is_running") is True

52	    print("SMOKE", "OK" if ok else "FAIL")

54	
55

#!/bin/sh
# Builds the macOS Bluetooth helper (ADR-0009). The daemon spawns it and treats
# stdin/stdout as the RFCOMM byte stream.
set -eu

SRC_DIR=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)
OUT_DIR="${1:-$SRC_DIR/../../build/bt_helper}"
mkdir -p "$OUT_DIR"

swiftc -O "$SRC_DIR/main.swift" \
    -o "$OUT_DIR/liino-bt-helper" \
    -framework IOBluetooth
codesign --force --sign - "$OUT_DIR/liino-bt-helper"
echo "Built $OUT_DIR/liino-bt-helper"

85	    };

87	    let mut rb = BoundedRingBuffer::new(64);
88	    for i in 0..16 {
89	        rb.push_overwrite(i);
90	    }
91	    let snap = EngineSnapshot {
92	        role_mode: parsed_mode,
93	        resolved_role: resolved,
94	        is_running: false,
95	        rtt_ms: 0,
96	        jitter_ms: 0.0,
97	        packet_loss: 0.0,
98	        ring_buffer_len: rb.len(),
99	        ring_buffer_capacity: rb.capacity(),
100	    };
101	    Ok(FrbEngineSnapshot {
102	        role_mode: mode,
103	        resolved_role: match snap.resolved_role {
104	            ResolvedRole::Sender => "sender".to_string(),
105	            ResolvedRole::Receiver => "receiver".to_string(),
106	        },
107	        is_running: snap.is_running,
108	        rtt_ms: snap.rtt_ms,
109	        jitter_ms: snap.jitter_ms,
110	        packet_loss: snap.packet_loss,
111	        ring_buffer_len: snap.ring_buffer_len,
112	        ring_buffer_capacity: snap.ring_buffer_capacity,
113	    })
114	}

149	async fn join_tasks_bounded(mut tasks: Vec<JoinHandle<()>>, timeout: std::time::Duration) {
150	    let deadline = tokio::time::Instant::now() + timeout;
151	    while let Some(mut task) = tasks.pop() {
152	        if tokio::time::timeout_at(deadline, &mut task).await.is_err() {
153	            log::warn!("[Server] network task did not stop in time, aborting the rest");
154	            task.abort();
155	            let _ = task.await;
156	            for task in &tasks {
157	                task.abort();
158	            }
159	            for task in tasks {
160	                let _ = task.await;
161	            }
162	            break;
163	        }
164	    }
165	}

167	async fn rollback_start(
168	    state: &ServerState,
169	    cancel_token: &CancellationToken,
170	    tasks: Vec<JoinHandle<()>>,
171	) -> Result<(), String> {
172	    cancel_token.cancel();
173	    crate::transport::tcp::cleanup_session_state(
174	        &state.active_connection,
175	        &state.active_audio_session,
176	    )
177	    .await;
178	    join_tasks_bounded(tasks, NETWORK_TASK_JOIN_TIMEOUT).await;
179	    state.cancel_token.lock().await.take();

36	    val buffer: ByteArray,
37	    @ProtoNumber(2)
38	    val sampleRate: Int,
39	    @ProtoNumber(3)
40	    val channelCount: Int,
41	    @ProtoNumber(4)
42	    val audioFormat: Int,
43	    // 0 = PCM（旧版默认），1 = Opus。Opus 载荷为压缩音频，
44	    // audioFormat 仍描述采集格式仅供遥测，解码不依赖它。
45	    @ProtoNumber(5)
46	    val codec: Int = 0
47	) {
48	    override fun equals(other: Any?): Boolean {
49	        if (this === other) return true
50	        if (other == null || this::class != other::class) return false
51	
52	        other as AudioPacketMessage
53	
54	        if (!buffer.contentEquals(other.buffer)) return false
55	        if (sampleRate != other.sampleRate) return false
56	        if (channelCount != other.channelCount) return false
57	        if (audioFormat != other.audioFormat) return false
58	        if (codec != other.codec) return false
59	
60	        return true
61	    }
62	
63	    override fun hashCode(): Int {
64	        var result = buffer.contentHashCode()
65	        result = 31 * result + sampleRate
66	        result = 31 * result + channelCount
67	        result = 31 * result + audioFormat
68	        result = 31 * result + codec
69	        return result
70	    }
71	}

131	 * Carries plugin-bus traffic between the phone and desktop plugins (e.g. the

133	 * the host bus (0 = one-way); `target` empty = broadcast; `errorCode` mirrors
134	 * the plugin error codes (0 = ok). Payload semantics are defined by the

143	    val target: String = "",
144	    @ProtoNumber(3)
145	    val topic: String = "",
146	    @ProtoNumber(4)
147	    val payload: ByteArray = ByteArray(0),
148	    // uint64 on the wire; correlation ids stay well below Long.MAX in practice.
149	    @ProtoNumber(5)
150	    val correlationId: Long = 0,
151	    @ProtoNumber(6)
152	    val isResponse: Boolean = false,
153	    @ProtoNumber(7)
154	    val errorCode: Int = 0,
155	    @ProtoNumber(8)
156	    val errorMessage: String = ""
157	) {
158	    override fun equals(other: Any?): Boolean {
159	        if (this === other) return true
160	        if (other == null || this::class != other::class) return false
161	
162	        other as PluginMessage
163	
164	        if (source != other.source) return false
165	        if (target != other.target) return false
166	        if (topic != other.topic) return false
167	        if (!payload.contentEquals(other.payload)) return false
168	        if (correlationId != other.correlationId) return false
169	        if (isResponse != other.isResponse) return false
170	        if (errorCode != other.errorCode) return false
171	        if (errorMessage != other.errorMessage) return false
172	
173	        return true
174	    }
175	
176	    override fun hashCode(): Int {
177	        var result = source.hashCode()
178	        result = 31 * result + target.hashCode()
179	        result = 31 * result + topic.hashCode()
180	        result = 31 * result + payload.contentHashCode()
181	        result = 31 * result + correlationId.hashCode()
182	        result = 31 * result + isResponse.hashCode()
183	        result = 31 * result + errorCode
184	        result = 31 * result + errorMessage.hashCode()
185	        return result
186	    }

190	const val HANDSHAKE_CLIENT = "MicYouCheck1"
191	const val HANDSHAKE_SERVER = "MicYouCheck2"
192	const val PACKET_MAGIC = 0x4D696359 // "MicY" in ASCII
193	const val UDP_PACKET_MAGIC = 0x4D696355 // "MicU" in ASCII
194	/** ConnectMessage.platform 取值，与 micyou-core 的 ClientPlatform 对应 */
195	const val CLIENT_PLATFORM = "android"
196	/** TCP 控制帧负载上限，与 micyou-core 的 MAX_CONTROL_PAYLOAD_LEN 一致 */
197	const val MAX_CONTROL_PAYLOAD_SIZE = 1024 * 1024
198	const val UDP_CUSTOM_HEADER_SIZE = 8
199	const val UDP_MAX_DATAGRAM_SIZE = 1472
200	// 为自定义头、嵌套 protobuf、64 位字段及 FEC 长度元数据预留最坏情况预算。
201	const val UDP_PCM_PAYLOAD_SIZE = 1320
202	
203	/** 音频 buffer 编码：0 = PCM（旧版默认），1 = Opus */
204	const val CODEC_PCM = 0
205	const val CODEC_OPUS = 1
206	
207	/** UDP 端口 = TCP 端口 + 1 */
208	const val UDP_PORT_OFFSET = 1
209	
210	/**
211	 * 计算 UDP 端口，带边界校验防止端口溢出。
212	 * @param tcpPort TCP 端口号
213	 * @return UDP 端口号
214	 * @throws IllegalArgumentException 当计算结果超出有效端口范围 (0-65535)
215	 */
216	fun calculateUdpPort(tcpPort: Int): Int {
217	    val udpPort = tcpPort + UDP_PORT_OFFSET
218	    if (udpPort !in 0..65535) {
219	        throw IllegalArgumentException("UDP 端口溢出: TCP 端口 $tcpPort + 偏移量 $UDP_PORT_OFFSET = $udpPort，超出有效范围 0-65535")
220	    }
221	    return udpPort
222	}

#### Thinking

Now I have the wire protocol precisely:
- TCP handshake: client sends "MicYouCheck1", server replies "MicYouCheck2".
- Then protobuf MessageWrapper frames with PACKET_MAGIC 0x4D696359 header.
- ConnectMessage{sessionId, platform="android", transport="tcp"|"both"}.
- AudioPacketMessageOrdered{sequenceNumber, audioPacket:AudioPacketMessage{buffer,sampleRate,channelCount,audioFormat,codec=1 Opus}, timestamp, fec..., sessionId}.
- UDP magic 0x4D696355, custom header 8 bytes, max datagram 1472.
- Control (connect/mute/ping/pong/plugin) over TCP; audio over UDP (both) or TCP (tcp-only).

This is protobuf-based (micyou-protocol/proto/network.proto). The Rust side has micyou-protocol with prost-generated structs. So a Rust sender can reuse micyou_protocol::MessageWrapper etc. + micyou-core transport::opus for encode. That's clean and cross-platform.

Now the decision: Rust sender (in liino, reusing micyou-protocol + opus) exposed via FRB, vs Kotlin port. 

Given liino's architecture (Rust core + FRB + thin Flutter) and that micyou-protocol already has the prost structs + micyou-core has opus encode + the receiver's exact frame parsing (tcp.rs), a **Rust sender client** is the right, cross-platform choice. It reuses the same protocol crate the receiver uses, guaranteeing wire compat. Mic capture on Android via cpal (micyou-audio uses cpal; cpal supports Android). {
  "content": "//! Remote key trigger (no pairing): the phone sends tap / down / up actions over\n//! the existing audio connection as a cross-device plugin message on topic\n//! `liino.remote_key`; the daemon synthesizes the configured desktop key so a\n//! bound hotkey (e.g. a voice-input trigger) fires without touching the keyboard.\n//!\n//! Injection is OFF by default (dry-run logs only) so an unattended desktop never\n//! receives stray keystrokes; the user arms it explicitly over IPC.\n\nuse std::sync::atomic::{AtomicBool, AtomicU16, Ordering};\n\nuse serde::Deserialize;\n\n/// macOS virtual keycode for F13; override over IPC to match the bound hotkey.\nconst DEFAULT_TARGET_KEY: u16 = 106;\n\nstatic ARMED: AtomicBool = AtomicBool::new(false);\nstatic TARGET_KEY: AtomicU16 = AtomicU16::new(DEFAULT_TARGET_KEY);\n\n#[derive(Deserialize)]\nstruct KeyAction {\n    action: String,\n}\n\npub fn set_enabled(enabled: bool) {\n    ARMED.store(enabled, Ordering::Relaxed);\n}\n\npub fn enabled() -> bool {\n    ARMED.load(Ordering::Relaxed)\n}\n\npub fn set_target(keycode: u16) {\n    TARGET_KEY.store(keycode, Ordering::Relaxed);\n}\n\npub fn target() -> u16 {\n    TARGET_KEY.load(Ordering::Relaxed)\n}\n\npub fn handle_payload(payload: &[u8]) {\n    let parsed: KeyAction = match serde_json::from_slice(payload) {\n        Ok(p) => p,\n        Err(e) => {\n            eprintln!(\"[remote-key] bad payload: {e}\");\n            return;\n        }\n    };\n    let action = parsed.action.as_str();\n    if !matches!(action, \"tap\" | \"down\" | \"up\") {\n        eprintln!(\"[remote-key] unknown action: {action}\");\n        return;\n    }\n    if !enabled() {\n        eprintln!(\"[remote-key] dry-run (disarmed): {action} key={}\", target());\n        return;\n    }\n    synthesize(action, target());\n}\n\n#[cfg(target_os = \"macos\")]\nfn synthesize(action: &str, keycode: u16) {\n    use core_graphics::event::{CGEvent, CGEventTapLocation, CGKeyCode};\n    let post = |down: bool| {\n        if let Some(ev) = CGEvent::new_keyboard_event(None, keycode as CGKeyCode, down) {\n            ev.post(CGEventTapLocation::HID);\n        }\n    };\n    match action {\n        \"down\" => post(true),\n        \"up\" => post(false),\n        _ => {\n            post(true);\n            post(false);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n#[cfg(not(target_os = \"macos\"))]\nfn synthesize(action: &str, keycode: u16) {\n    eprintln!(\"[remote-key] key synthesis not implemented on this platform: {action} key={keycode}\");\n}",
  "file_path": "/Users/glow/Base/Code/Prometheus/Liino/crates/liino-daemon/src/remote_key.rs"
}

{
  "content": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Probe the liino remote-key path without a microphone.\n\nDoes the MicYou TCP handshake + connect, then sends a cross-device\nPluginMessage on topic liino.remote_key. With the daemon disarmed (default)\nit must log a dry-run line; nothing is injected into the desktop.\n\"\"\"\nimport json\nimport socket\nimport sys\nimport time\n\nHOST = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else \"127.0.0.1\"\nPORT = int(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv) > 2 else 8554\nACTION = sys.argv[3] if len(sys.argv) > 3 else \"tap\"\nMAGIC = 0x4D696359\n\n\ndef varint(n):\n    out = b\"\"\n    while True:\n        b = n & 0x7F\n        n >>= 7\n        out += bytes([b | (0x80 if n else 0)])\n        if not n:\n            return out\n\n\ndef ld(field, data):\n    return bytes([(field << 3) | 2]) + varint(len(data)) + data\n\n\ndef vi(field, n):\n    return bytes([(field << 3) | 0]) + varint(n)\n\n\ndef frame(payload):\n    return MAGIC.to_bytes(4, \"big\") + len(payload).to_bytes(4, \"big\") + payload\n\n\ndef main():\n    s = socket.create_connection((HOST, PORT), timeout=5)\n    s.sendall(b\"MicYouCheck1\")\n    reply = s.recv(12)\n    assert reply == b\"MicYouCheck2\", reply\n    connect = vi(1, int(time.time() * 1000)) + ld(2, b\"android\") + ld(3, b\"tcp\")\n    s.sendall(frame(ld(2, connect)))\n    pm = (\n        ld(1, b\"liino-remote\")\n        + ld(2, b\"\")\n        + ld(3, b\"liino.remote_key\")\n        + ld(4, json.dumps({\"action\": ACTION}).encode())\n    )\n    s.sendall(frame(ld(7, pm)))\n    time.sleep(0.5)\n    print(\"sent remote_key\", ACTION, \"to\", HOST, PORT)\n    s.close()\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    main()",
